title: Swirl
tagline: Swirl  is a decentralized and non-custodial privacy solution for EVM chains
description:
Swirl  is a decentralized and non-custodial privacy solution for EVM Chains. It allows users to deposit Ether (ETH) anonymously and withdraw it in a way that makes it impossible to link the withdrawal to the original deposit.

This project is inspired from Tornado Cash  launched in 2019 by Roman Storm, a pseudonymous developer who has been active in the Ethereum space since 2017. The idea behind Tornado Cash is to provide users with a way to protect their financial privacy on the blockchain.
how_its_made:
Currently,It is a smart contract with 2 major functions deposit and withdraw
When a user wants to deposit ETH into Swirl, they first  send  some amount of ETH to a Swirl pool ,which also consists other deposits, making it impossible to trace which deposit belongs to which user and gets an unique note

 Users can withdraw their ETH by calling the withdraw function and passing in a valid Tornado Cash note and a withdrawal address where they want to receive their ETH.
